title: Did You Train on My Dataset? Towards Public Dataset Protection with Clean-Label Backdoor Watermarking
reasoning: The paper focuses on developing and evaluating a technical framework for intellectual property protection of datasets. It discusses 'unauthorized exploitation' and 'safeguarding datasets' which are related to ethical concerns in data usage, but it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as its primary subject matter. The ethical component is peripheral to the technical solution for IP protection.
